info.title: Shopno Jatra API
info.description: World-Class Production-Grade Asynchronous Backend for Shopno Jatra Travel Ecosystem. Features Supabase PostgreSQL integration, Zero-Trust RBAC security, SIMD-accelerated ORJSON serialization, L1/L2 hybrid caching, resilient payment webhook processing, and real-time WebSockets.

post.description:
Check if an email is registered without triggering Supabase Auth brute-force
or rate limit counters. Returns clean boolean existence indicator.

Essential for Zero-Trust auditing and mobile SDK client debugging.

Returns paginated flight routes matching origin and destination.

Generate single-use S3/Cloudflare R2 PUT presigned upload URL.

Unified Conversational AI Chat Endpoint.
Securely routes chat queries to Google Gemini SDK (google-genai) on the backend.
Protects API keys and provides intelligent local failover.

Single-turn LLM Text / JSON Completion Endpoint.
Used by provider adapters (GeminiProvider, etc.) to securely offload LLM prompts to the backend.

Conversational search query parser for English & Banglish.
Extracts entities (destination, budget_max, duration_days, amenities, dates, traveler_count),
matches multi-vertical intent, and expands synonyms with pre-computed vector embeddings.

Generate customized structured day-by-day itinerary using Google Gemini SDK (google-genai).
Features defensive JSON schema validation and persists trip plan for user.

Generate customized structured day-by-day itinerary using Google Gemini SDK (google-genai).
Features defensive JSON schema validation and persists trip plan for user.

Multi-dimensional aspect sentiment and vibe analysis for hotels and destinations.
Performs linguistic perplexity spam filtering, calculates 5 travel dimension
meters (Cleanliness, Hospitality, Value for Money, Wi-Fi / Remote Work, Scenic Serenity),
and synthesizes dynamic vibe tags.

Calculates real-time demand elasticity multiplier for bus seats, launch cabins, and holiday stays. Strictly enforces fair price ceiling (max 1.25x), transparent explanations, and provides a 15-minute price lock token.
Validates that a 15-minute locked price quote has not expired and has not been tampered with.
Predict price fluctuations over next 14 days with confidence intervals and BUY_NOW/WAIT advice.

get.description: Compute 14-day flight fare forecast based on current route pricing, seat occupancy, and velocity.
Compute 14-day hotel room price forecast using room inventory velocity and seasonality.

post.description:
Score destinations, hotels, and tours across the 40 real-time parameters.
Executes hybrid content-based cosine similarity and collaborative filtering,
with Thompson Sampling multi-armed bandit fallback for cold-start users.
Returns strictly validated confidence scores in [0.0 - 1.0].

Cold-start recommendation endpoint powered by Thompson Sampling multi-armed bandit.
Samples regional posterior probabilities (Cox's Bazar, Sylhet, Sajek, Sundarbans).

Record user interaction feedback to update Thompson Sampling Beta distributions.
Reward signal: 1.0 for positive interactions (clicks, bookings, high dwell time),
0.0 for bounces or impressions without interaction.

post.description:
Generate an ephemeral presigned PUT URL for direct client upload of KYC documents to R2.
- Validates MIME type whitelist: application/pdf, image/png, image/jpeg.
- Validates file size under configured limit (10MB).
- Returns single-use S3 PUT URL with strictly enforced 5-minute expiry.
- Never returns a permanent or public URL.

Submit agency KYC documents for verification review.
Validates all 4 required document types:
- Trade Licence (trade_licence)
- Tax Identification Number (tin)
- Owner/Director ID (owner_id)
- Office Address Proof (address_proof)
Transitions submission status to 'submitted', writes immutable audit log,
and enqueues background Celery vision & rule check analysis.

get.description:
Retrieve current agency KYC verification status, uploaded document metadata,
extracted compliance checks, and feedback reason if changes were requested.
Includes ephemeral 5-minute presigned GET URLs for document previews.

Administrator endpoint: List pending KYC submissions queue.
Strictly ordered by OLDEST submitted_at first to enforce fair FIFO SLA processing.

Administrator endpoint: Get detailed submission data for side-by-side inspection.
Returns:
- Agency metadata
- Documents with ephemeral 5-minute presigned GET URLs
- AI vision extracted fields (owner ID redacted where appropriate)
- Color-coded automated rule checks (pass/warn/fail)
- Complete audit log trail

post.description:
Administrator endpoint: Approve agency KYC.
Transitions status to 'verified', updates agency.verified_at, agency.verified_by,
unblocks ledger payouts, and appends an immutable audit entry to kyc_audit_log.

Administrator endpoint: Reject agency KYC.
Decision reason is strictly mandatory.
Transitions status to 'rejected', updates agency.verification_status,
and appends an immutable audit entry to kyc_audit_log.

Administrator endpoint: Request changes on agency KYC submission.
Detailed feedback reason is strictly mandatory.
Transitions status to 'needs_changes', permitting agency to re-upload and resubmit.
Appends an immutable audit entry to kyc_audit_log.
